summary: The dashboard presents bounded public Actions and merged-delivery populations separately from retained historical host snapshots. It displays existing launcher record gaps without treating them as a matched expected-dispatch denominator, preserves missing quantities as Unknown, and does not infer whole-population priced cost. Actions, public-delivery and store-snapshot observation clocks remain distinct from data build time; absent whole-population producer, ingestion and publication receipts are unavailable, and browser refresh cannot establish producer freshness. Canonical per-item measurements, their denominators, analysis availability/failures and approved evidence remain visible without an assessment dependency. Causal explanations, avoidable-work shares and avoidable-purpose claims, recommendations and savings are deferred in presentation; the closed projection validator is retained. Invalid delivery observation timestamps are rejected before replacing the last valid view. This source behavior establishes neither a current runtime collection route nor installed, publication or browser operational acceptance; retired host publication destinations remain retired.
title: Dashboard facts retain independent coverage and source clocks
